description: Line 9 explicitly pledges the MUST-only discipline: '"任意/optional/推奨" は使わない（HARD 0.7）— 全て MUST.' The spec then repeatedly violates its own rule with soft/optional qualifiers that leave scope undecided: line 84 'keep as optional; not prioritized' (token-launch), line 83 and OQ5 'stretch ... stretch slot' (earn/audit), line 74 'de-prioritized' (clip/affiliate). Each of these is an optional/推奨-equivalent hedge that HARD 0.7 forbids and that leaves whether the item is in-scope undetermined. Either commit them as MUST with a bound, or move them out of the feature entirely.

evidence.snippet: "任意/optional/推奨" は使わない ... [yet] keep as optional; not prioritized ... (stretch, strong-model only) ... de-prioritized
